$about: Declarative input for scripts/build-photos.mjs. See REDESIGN-PLAN.md section 7.
Sources live in assets/photos-source/ and are never published: Vite copies public/ verbatim,
and the 15 originals are 41MB. Only the derivatives named here reach dist/.
Crop boxes are in SOURCE pixels. Every source is 4000x2252, EXIF orientation 1.
Consent: participants signed off on appearing in IFN marketing material (founder ruling 2026-08-09).
Venue: Capital Factory was rebranded Station Austin. Its signage in these frames is dated, not dishonest.
REWRITTEN 2026-08-10, second gallery round, on a founder ruling that supersedes the first one.
1. ALL FIFTEEN SOURCES NOW SHIP. Every exclusion, reserve and not-selected status in the previous
revision is overridden by the founder, who has personally vetted every photograph. The five that
venue/20260226_184645, venue/20260723_175654) are in. Their old reasons are NOT reproduced here,
because a reason recorded beside a frame that ships is a reason the next reader will try to act on.
The audit trail lives in git and in REDESIGN-PLAN.md section 7; the pool block below is now empty
and says why. Do not re-litigate any of the five on quality, composition, flags, former venue
branding or genre.
2. THE NIGHT GROUPING IS GONE. The previous revision carried a top level galleryNights array and a
per slot gallery.night key, and the build emitted the gallery as three dated groups. The founder's
objection is that three dated evenings read as a claim that three evenings are all there have been,
which is false. No date, no evening label and no per night structure survives anywhere in this file
or in the generated TypeScript. The source filename stays as the internal key that traces a frame
back to its original, and the build prints a slot to source table as a COMMENT in the generated
file so a human can follow it without any date derived value reaching a component at runtime.
3. VISIBLE CAPTIONS AND PER PHOTO DESCRIPTIONS ARE GONE, ALT TEXT IS NOT. This file never carried a
caption field, so nothing is deleted here; the removal is in the components. The alt attribute is
a different object from a caption: it is invisible to a sighted reader and it is the only way a
screen reader user perceives that a photograph exists or what is in it. Removing it would be the
accessibility regression REDESIGN-PLAN.md section 8 forbids. Every one of the fifteen frames below
carries hand written alt, five of them written new in this round, and one (gallery-jul-standing)
corrected because it was factually wrong about its own frame.
4. THE GALLERY IS NO LONGER A UNIFORM GRID, SO THERE IS NO LONGER A SINGLE TILE WIDTH. The composition
is an authored hang of nine unequal rows on a twelve column measure, and cell width runs from 389 to
906 CSS px. tileWidth per slot is therefore set from the cell that slot occupies, on the rule
tileWidth = max(cell tier, 640). The ladder is 640, 704, 832, 960 and it is the composition's six
size classes folded onto four tiers, because classes 4, 5 and 6 all sit under the 640 floor and
cannot be served anything smaller.
THE 640 FLOOR IS 97.6 PERCENT OF ITS OWN DERIVATION AND THAT IS STATED RATHER THAN ROUNDED AWAY.
Under 640px viewport width the composition puts every frame at the full 328px container measure,
which wants 656px at a device pixel ratio of 2. 640 is 16px short of that, a 2.4 percent shortfall.
It is accepted rather than paid for with a fifth tier: 640 is the shipped precedent from the previous
revision, where the whole grid rendered at 100vw on phones off a 640 tile, and buying the last 2.4
percent would add a tier to every one of the ten frames that sit on this floor. Nothing here clears
656; the floor is 640 and it under-serves a 2x phone by 16px.
5. THREE LANDING SLOTS WERE RESELECTED. hero-band moves from meetups/20260423_184515 to
meetups/20260423_184527, founder-story moves from meetups/20260226_184622 to
meetups/20260723_190939, and how-it-works-middle survived a fresh comparison unchanged. The
founder's instruction was that the landing photography favour people, faces and energy, and that
the FounderStory frame in particular was a large empty hall with no readable face in it. That is
accurate about meetups/20260226_184622, which now appears only in the gallery, as gallery-feb-hall.
6. how-it-works-middle-reserve WAS DELETED. Its source, meetups/20260723_190939, is now spent on
founder-story, and its stated purpose (separating the two day one photographs by date) belonged to
a page that no longer exists. hero-band-reserve is KEPT: its source ships as gallery-feb-sign, but a
reserve slot is a crop box held ready at the hero's own ratio, not a claim on the source, and a
standing fallback for the one eager image on the site is worth the eleven lines it costs.

budget.$note: REDESIGN-PLAN.md section 7. Measured at build, never estimated.
$landingNote: Every avif tier a 1440px viewport at 1x actually selects on the landing route, named as data.
The runner used to hardcode this list in JavaScript while carrying a comment claiming it did not,
and the comment was right about the hazard: a hand written list goes stale by printing PASS, which
is the worst direction for a check to fail in. Adding a photographic slot to the landing page means
adding a row here, and forgetting is a MISSING entry rather than a silently short total.
The last three rows are GalleryPreview's frames on the home page. They are gallery slots rendered a
second time on the landing route rather than separate builds, so their tier is whatever tileWidth
the GALLERY composition gives them, not a number chosen for the home page. The lead is an 832w tile
for that reason alone: it is the span 8 cell of the hang, and at the roughly 690 CSS px this section
gives it that is above 1x rather than upscaled.
REPLACED LATE IN THE SAME ROUND, on GalleryPreview's own handover note. The three rows here were
gallery-feb-sign, gallery-apr-floor and gallery-jul-standing until the integrator reselected the
section, because two of the old three had just become landing page sources at other slots:
gallery-apr-listening is the hero band's frame and gallery-jul-standing is FounderStory's, so leaving
either here would print one photograph twice on one page. The resolved set was gallery-apr-seated,
gallery-apr-circle and gallery-feb-sign, read off LEAD_SLOTS and STACKED_SLOTS in
src/components/GalleryPreview.tsx rather than guessed. Those two arrays are ordered preference lists
with fallbacks, so if a candidate is ever dropped from the manifest the section resolves to a
different frame and these rows go stale by printing PASS on the wrong selection. Re-read the arrays,
do not assume.
REPLACED AGAIN, SAME ROUND, AND FOR THE SAME CLASS OF DEFECT ONE STEP FURTHER OUT. The check above
compares SLOT NAMES, and gallery-apr-seated and the hero band are different slots pointing at
different files, so it passed. A design pre-flight then opened the two rendered frames and found
meetups/20260423_184523.jpg and meetups/20260423_184527.jpg are the same circle four seconds apart:
one photograph printed twice on the home page, invisible to every automated check in this repository
because no check compares pictures. The lead is now gallery-apr-group, the group portrait at the end
of the April evening, which is the most legible faces in the folder and cannot be confused with any
other frame on the page. The resolved set is gallery-apr-group, gallery-apr-circle and
gallery-feb-sign, at 832, 640 and 640. Adding a landing frame means LOOKING at the frames already on
the page, not only at their slot names.

$galleryNote: THE CAP MOVED IN THIS ROUND AND THE ARITHMETIC IS WRITTEN OUT RATHER THAN ASSERTED.
It was 262,144 bytes and it was set against ten frames at one uniform 640px tile, which measured
158,781 bytes, 60.6 percent of it. That artifact no longer exists. Fifteen frames on a four tier
ladder measure 272,765 bytes, which is 104.1 percent of the old cap. Shaving the largest cell from
960 to 896 would buy about 4KB and squeak under a number that stopped describing the thing it was
measuring, so the cap is restated instead: 286,720 bytes, which is the measured 272,765 plus 5.1
percent, enough headroom to re-crop one frame without a budget edit and not enough to absorb a
sixteenth. Raising a cap is worse than meeting one and this is recorded as a raise, not a pass.
WHAT THIS NUMBER IS AND IS NOT. It is every avif tile in the composition summed, which is what a
visitor pays across a FULL SCROLL of a page measured by the designer at 4,294px tall at 1440. It is
NOT what they pay on arrival. The old note claimed the two were the same, which was defensible for a
short uniform grid and is not defensible for a nine row hang. Arrival cost is R1 alone, the 960 tier
of gallery-apr-room, and it is conditional on the integrator giving every frame below the fold
loading=lazy. That attribute is not in this file and cannot be enforced from here, so the runner
prints the figure labelled as conditional rather than as a budget line.
Enlarged views are excluded from the cap on the same basis as before: they are fetched on
interaction and most visitors never open one.

galleryAboveFoldAt1440x900.why: R1, the only cell wholly above the fold at 900px

$note: Baked in at build so the grade costs nothing at runtime.
whiteBalance is a per channel multiplier applied with the levels move, not a separate pass.
blackPoint and whitePoint are fractions of full range: out = wb * (white - black) * in + black * 255.
The grade keys are still named for the evening each source was shot on. That is a property of the
LIGHT in the room, which is why the three corrections differ, and it is build input that never
reaches a component. Nothing date derived is emitted.

april-2026.note: Daylight through a full height glass wall. Measured on the hero crop: mean RGB 93.6 / 94.8 / 91.7, so red sits 1.3 percent over green and blue 3.4 percent over green. That is neutral inside any correction worth applying, so none is applied.

february-2026.note: REDESIGN-PLAN.md section 7 calls this night a green cast. The files do not agree and this is the measurement that corrects it: on the sign crop mean RGB is 61.4 / 64.3 / 77.6, so blue runs 21 percent over green and red 4.5 percent under it. The cast is blue, not green. A full grey world correction would be [1.0475, 1.0, 0.8286] and it erases the night by neutralising a window that really is that colour, so this is half of it, which reads as a cool room rather than a lavender one. Verified by rendering, not by argument. Four frames now carry it.

july-2026.note: Evening interior under white LED strips. Measured on the standing group crop: mean RGB 126.1 / 118.1 / 114.0, so red runs 6.8 percent over green. That warmth is the room and correcting it out makes skin tones grey, so it is left alone. Checked by rendering. Three frames carry it, one of them now on the landing page.

whole as gallery-apr-room, at the largest cell in the gallery.
Full source width, so the vertical offset is the only free parameter and 585 is its maximum
(2252 minus 1667). Bottom anchored: it drops the ductwork ceiling and keeps every seated person.
Checked against the plan's one design preference on this frame by RENDERING it at 1440x600 rather
than reasoning about it: the brightest objects in the band are the large white IFN screen at the
left, the second IFN screen on the pillar and the glass wall, and the former venue gear reads as a
mid grey graphic behind the group. It is present, it is not the highest contrast object, and no
crop of this composition removes it without removing the room.
meetups/20260423_184509.jpg was tested for this slot at two vertical offsets and rejected on a
measurement rather than a preference: its IFN screens sit at source y 129 to 414, and no 2.4:1 crop
holds both those screens and the whole standing figure at the back. At top 380 the standing head is

Full source height, so the horizontal offset is the only free parameter and it is free across

slots.alt: One founder mid gesture in a small seated circle with the others listening, an IFN meetup slide on the screen behind them and the city through the window.

sizesNote: 904px is the full FounderStory grid at lg: the 36rem prose track, the 3.5rem gutter and the 17rem

NOTE FOR THE INTEGRATOR: this frame is 16:9 as before and its placement is unchanged, so the
Suspense fallback height for the FounderStory section does not move in this round.

$note: EMPTY AS OF 2026-08-10, and empty is the correct state rather than an oversight.
This block is the audit record for every source that has NO slot above. All fifteen sources now have
a slot and all fifteen ship, so there is nothing left to record. The founder has personally vetted
every photograph and overridden the previous exclusions of meetups/20260423_184523.jpg,
The old reasons are deliberately NOT preserved in this file. They were preserved for one round and
the invariant they existed to hold was that a source appears exactly once, either as something that
ships or as something that does not. Fifteen slots for fifteen sources satisfies that invariant
outright. Keeping a reason beside a frame that ships would break the thing the record was for: a
reader would have two statements about one photograph and nothing to say which is authoritative.
The history is in git and in REDESIGN-PLAN.md section 7, which was amended to match this file in the
same round.
The vocabulary is kept because the next photographs will need it. A frame shot after this date with
no recorded consent is still a no, per the standing rule in REDESIGN-PLAN.md section 7.
